children: Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) is doubling down on AI and logistics—locking multibillion cloud deals with Anthropic and Generac, expanding same‑day delivery via Project Mercury and growing AWS AI services—while facing regulatory probes, drone damage to AWS regions and rising debt-funded capex risks.
Previous Week Recap
Amazon.com, Inc. Wins Anthropic Deal
: Amazon (AMZN) won a deal with Anthropic: Anthropic will buy over $100 billion of AWS compute capacity across 10 years, boosting Amazon's long-term cloud revenue exposure.
AWS Bahrain/UAE Outages; Repairs Delay
: AMZN: AWS reported Bahrain region irrecoverable after drone strikes; UAE availability zone damaged and repair expected months away. Bahrain fixes may arrive early 2027. Shares fell about 1.5–2%.
Project Mercury Expansion To 1,000+ Sites
: Amazon (AMZN) plans Project Mercury to expand U.S. same‑day delivery from ~85 to 1,000+ sites by 2031, stocking ~90,000 SKUs; expects $6.8B investment in 2026–27 and ~$7.1B 10‑yr value
FTC States Sue Amazon Over Surcharge
: FTC and 22 states sued Amazon, alleging it hid a surcharge that inflated bids in its search ad auctions, accusing the company of deceptive, unfair ad-auction mechanics affecting advertisers.
Generac Backup Deal Worth Billions
: Amazon agreed a long‑term deal with Generac for backup generators: ~$2.4B in deliveries in 2027–28, up to $8B total. Amazon holds a warrant for 1,693,745 Generac shares, exercisable to 2033.
Q2 Revenue And Profit Growth
: AMZN Q2 revenue $200.6B (+20% YoY); North America sales $116.2B (+16%); operating income $27.5B (+43%). Results released ahead of the holiday season.
Amazon Raises Public Debt With Notes
: Amazon (AMZN) raised about £4.24B (~$5.74B) via public notes maturing 2029–2045; proceeds ~£4.24B. Debt issued under amended 2012 indenture.
EU Probes Third‑Party Pricing Practices

: EU opens probe into Amazon (AMZN) over alleged restrictions on third‑party seller pricing across its EU marketplace; investigators reviewing Amazon’s marketplace policies and seller pricing practices
Hyperscalers Debt‑Fueled AI Capex Warning
: Jefferies warns hyperscalers, including Amazon (AMZN), are funding US AI capex increasingly with debt; a credit‑tightening could quickly halt Amazon’s AI spending cycle.
AWS AI Work: AGI, Bedrock, Alexa
: AMZN highlighted AWS AI work: an AGI unit powering Alexa and the Bedrock marketplace offering AI infra and third‑party models, noting these are part of its AI services and ops.
